segments.text:
V. 17.
New—Fermenting wine will ſoon burſt thoſe bottles, the Leather of which is almoſt worn out. The Word properly means Veſſels made of Goats Skins, wherein they formerly put Wine (and do in ſome Countries to this Day) to convey it from Place to Place. Put new wine into new bottles—Give harſh Doctrines to ſuch as have Strength to receive them.
